title: ATMECE CELEBRATED TEACHER’S DAY &  ENGINEER’S DAY-2021
content:
ATMECE CELEBRATED TEACHER’S DAY & ENGINEER’S DAY-2021

ATME College of Engineering, Bannur road Mysuru was celebrated Teacher’s Day and Engineer’s day-2021 at the college auditorium. The program was inaugurated by Chief Guest Dr. Vilas Kara jinni, Vice chancellor, JSS Science and Technological University by lighting the lamp. The Management of ATME felicitated Sri. H M Srinivas, Principal Mandavaya Excellent PU College and Sri Goole Gowda Principal, Government PU College Bannur, for their remarkable contribution to the society in the field of Education. On this occasion Dr. Suresh kumar, Associate professor Department of Mechanical Engineering,        Dr.Satish K R, Assistant professor, Department of Electrical & Electronics Engineering and Dr. Muralidhar M P were felicitated for obtaining Doctoral Degrees in their respective field of specialization. the gathering Dr.Vilas Karajnni Vice Chancellor of JSSSTU asked the faculty fraternity to make use of the technological advancement to overcome the challenges posed during Covid-19 pandemic and he emphasized on the adoption of the virtual teaching methods in an effective method. During his presidential remarks Sri L.Arun kumar Chairman ATME College of Engineering expressed that teaching is a Nobel service to the mankind and should not be viewed as a profession and he further opined that teacher plays a vital role in moulding the society.
